collection_name: Cloud-9 Assembly: TNG Validation, Personal Genomics, K-Star SETI, and Quantum Null

cross_domain_patterns.description: A_c shows strong mass-dependence across TNG analyses, masking intrinsic complexity signal
Multiple independent tests fail to reject null hypothesis (p > 0.05)
Spatial position and formation history affect A_c in non-trivial ways
Personal genomics provides strongest empirical foundation in this batch

meta_analysis.collection_verdict: MIXED — TNG validation produces null results requiring formula revision; personal genomics is solid; K-SETI and microtubule concepts remain speculative

C9-2026-TNG-AC-V1.title: TNG100-1 A_c Analysis v1.0 — Quiescent Halo Complexity
C9-2026-TNG-AC-V1.methodology: Compute A_c for quiescent halos; compare inliers vs outliers via statistical test
C9-2026-TNG-AC-V1.verdict: NULL RESULT — No evidence for A_c deficit in quiescent halos. Formula may be insensitive to the relevant physics, or quiescence does not correlate with complexity reduction in TNG.
C9-2026-TNG-AC-V1.key_risk: A_c formula dominated by mass-dependent terms; may need environmental or dynamical history weighting
C9-2026-TNG-AC-V1.next_experiment: Test A_c on merger-tree temporal evolution; compare pre- and post-merger states within same halo lineage

C9-2026-TNG-AC-V2.title: TNG100-1 A_c Analysis v2.1 — Integrated Assembly Index
C9-2026-TNG-AC-V2.data_source: TNG100-1 snapshot 99, same 100 halos with v2.1 integrated formula
C9-2026-TNG-AC-V2.methodology: A_c^total = integrated complexity over halo history; exponential mass weighting at high M

extreme_outlier.note: Dwarf galaxy group or cluster core

C9-2026-TNG-AC-V2.verdict: NULL RESULT — v2.1 integration amplifies mass signal but does not reveal intrinsic complexity anomaly. The exponential high-mass behavior may be artifactual.
C9-2026-TNG-AC-V2.key_risk: Integration may compound mass-dependent bias; extreme outlier at A_c=12 suggests formula instability
C9-2026-TNG-AC-V2.next_experiment: Validate v2.1 against analytical expectations for idealized NFW halos; test convergence with resolution

C9-2026-TNG-SPATIAL.title: TNG100-1 Spatial Outlier Analysis — Environmental Suppression
C9-2026-TNG-SPATIAL.data_source: TNG100-1 halo positions (cm_x, cm_y, cm_z) in ckpc/h
C9-2026-TNG-SPATIAL.methodology: Spatial clustering of low-A_c halos; identify environmental outliers at large cm_x

key_results.low_ac_clustering: 25 low-A_c halos concentrated at low cm_x (clustered environment)
key_results.spatial_outliers: 9 halos at high cm_x, some with anomalous A_c

Topo.interpretation: Lower topological complexity in clustered environment

C9-2026-TNG-SPATIAL.verdict: INTERESTING PATTERN — Spatial clustering of low-A_c halos suggests environmental suppression, but not statistically significant at n=100. Needs larger sample and proper spatial correlation function analysis.
C9-2026-TNG-SPATIAL.key_risk: Small sample size; cm_x may be periodic boundary coordinate, not physical distance
C9-2026-TNG-SPATIAL.next_experiment: Compute two-point correlation function of A_c-weighted halo field; compare to mass-weighted field

C9-2026-TNG-MASS-TREND.title: TNG100-1 Mass Trend Removal — Intrinsic Complexity
C9-2026-TNG-MASS-TREND.data_source: TNG100-1, same halo sample with polynomial mass detrending
C9-2026-TNG-MASS-TREND.methodology: Fit U-shaped mass trend to A_c(M); examine residuals for intrinsic complexity signal

key_results.trend_shape: U-shaped: high at low mass → minimum at 3e11 M_sun → rises at high mass
key_results.residual_analysis: Low-intrinsic-complexity halos cluster at low cm_x; one extreme spatial outlier at (75000, 26200) ckpc/h

C9-2026-TNG-MASS-TREND.verdict: MASS DOMINATES — After removing mass trend, residual A_c shows weak environmental signal but no clear outlier pattern. The U-shaped trend itself is puzzling and may indicate formula nonlinearity.
C9-2026-TNG-MASS-TREND.key_risk: Polynomial detrending is model-dependent; U-shape may be overfit
C9-2026-TNG-MASS-TREND.next_experiment: Use semi-analytic model to predict A_c(M) for pure NFW halos; compare to TNG to isolate baryonic effects

C9-2026-TNG-MERGER.title: TNG100-1 Merger History vs A_c — Assembly Bias
C9-2026-TNG-MERGER.methodology: Correlate A_c with cumulative merger count and formation redshift
C9-2026-TNG-MERGER.verdict: COUNTER-INTUITIVE — More mergers slightly increase A_c (expected), but earlier formation REDUCES A_c. This suggests complexity erasure via dynamical relaxation over cosmic time, or that early-forming halos have more time to reach equilibrium.
C9-2026-TNG-MERGER.key_risk: Merger definition and timescale sensitivity; relaxation may erase complexity faster than mergers create it
C9-2026-TNG-MERGER.next_experiment: Track A_c along individual merger tree branches; test if A_c peaks at merger event then decays

C9-2026-KSTAR-INTELLIGENCE.title: K-Dwarf Convergence Model — Local Intelligence Lead Estimation
C9-2026-KSTAR-INTELLIGENCE.data_source: Stellar parameters for 8 nearby K-type stars
C9-2026-KSTAR-INTELLIGENCE.methodology: Estimate 'intelligence maturity lead' based on main-sequence age, flare activity, and metallicity

most_advanced.reasoning: Oldest (6+ Gyr), low flare rate, long remaining MS lifetime

most_behind.reasoning: Younger, more massive K1V, higher flare risk

tau_ceti.note: Well-studied target, slight age advantage over Sun

C9-2026-KSTAR-INTELLIGENCE.verdict: PLAUSIBLE SPECULATION — Astrophysical arguments are sound (longer MS lifetimes, lower flare rates favor biosphere stability), but 'intelligence lead' is anthropocentric and untestable. No direct biosignature data exists for any target.
C9-2026-KSTAR-INTELLIGENCE.key_risk: Assumes intelligence emergence is deterministic function of stellar age; ignores planetary factors (atmospheric retention, plate tectonics, moon stability)
C9-2026-KSTAR-INTELLIGENCE.next_experiment: Cross-reference with exoplanet catalogs (TESS, JWST) for habitable zone planets around top 3 targets; prioritize 61 Cygni A for technosignature search

C9-2026-PERSONAL-GENOMICS.title: AncestryDNA V2.0 — Personal Genomic Complexity Analysis
C9-2026-PERSONAL-GENOMICS.data_source: AncestryDNA V2.0 raw data (Jan 2019), ~5,000 SNPs on Chr 1
C9-2026-PERSONAL-GENOMICS.methodology: SNP-based health risk profiling, pharmacogenomics, ancestry inference

key_results.royal_ancestry: CANNOT BE DETERMINED from autosomal SNP array — requires Y-DNA/mtDNA haplogroup testing

C9-2026-PERSONAL-GENOMICS.verdict: SOLID EMPIRICAL ENTRY — Well-established genetic associations with clinical utility. MTHFR compound heterozygote is the most actionable finding. Could serve as biological baseline for Cloud-9 personal complexity tracking (e.g., epigenetic age, microbiome diversity integration).
C9-2026-PERSONAL-GENOMICS.key_risk: DTC genetic testing has limited clinical validation; false reassurance possible for 'no risk allele' results
C9-2026-PERSONAL-GENOMICS.next_experiment: Integrate with microbiome sequencing (16S/shotgun) and continuous glucose monitoring to build personal biological complexity time series; compare to population norms

C9-2026-MICROTUBULE-COSMIC.title: Microtubules as Cosmic Receivers — Strømme Φ Field & Orch-OR Entanglement
C9-2026-MICROTUBULE-COSMIC.data_source: Conceptual visualization only — no empirical data
C9-2026-MICROTUBULE-COSMIC.methodology: Theoretical synthesis of Penrose-Hameroff Orch-OR with hypothetical Strømme Φ field

visual_elements.cyan_lissajous: Quantum computational pathways or Φ field topology
visual_elements.yellow_nodes: Tubulin dimer quantum states / entanglement loci

key_results.mechanism: Undefined — no Hamiltonian, no coupling constant, no decoherence timescale
key_results.testable_prediction: None — requires room-temperature nanoscale quantum coherence detection in vivo

C9-2026-MICROTUBULE-COSMIC.verdict: LAYER 3 — MATHEMATICAL FICTION. The Strømme Φ field is not defined in standard physics literature. Orch-OR remains highly controversial with no experimental support.
C9-2026-MICROTUBULE-COSMIC.key_risk: Conceptual confusion — artistic visualization may be mistaken for physical theory
C9-2026-MICROTUBULE-COSMIC.next_experiment: If pursued: (1) Define Φ field mathematically, (2) Calculate predicted decoherence rate in microtubule environment, (3) Design interferometry experiment to test. Otherwise: archive as conceptual art and move on.

C9-2026-QUANTUM-NULL.title: IBM Quantum A_c Validation — NULL RESULT
C9-2026-QUANTUM-NULL.data_source: IBM Quantum 'fez' backend, job d92ouhfd07jc73dvkfdg, 4096 shots
C9-2026-QUANTUM-NULL.methodology: Run H⊗⁵ + measure circuit; encode message into qubit phases; compute A_c from measurement counts

key_results.message_independence: Same A_c for 'Peace.Love.789', 'Hello World', 'Quantum Cloud-9', random strings, empty message
key_results.i_dominance: I = 8192 = 32 states × 256 = CONSTANT for all 5-qubit circuits

C9-2026-QUANTUM-NULL.verdict: FAILED VALIDATION — The 'discovery' is an artifact of the A_c formula. I component (Dynamical Instability) is actually n_states × 256, a constant determined by Hilbert space dimension. The circuit (H⊗⁵ + measure) produces uniform random output regardless of message. Formula requires fundamental redesign before any quantum validation can proceed.
C9-2026-QUANTUM-NULL.key_risk: Continued use of this formula will produce false positives on any quantum hardware
C9-2026-QUANTUM-NULL.next_experiment: REDESIGN A_c quantum component: (1) Replace I with entropy deviation from uniform, (2) Use message-encoding circuits (amplitude encoding, QAOA), (3) Add quantum mutual information between input message and output distribution, (4) Re-test on simulator before hardware
